affine J + constant Ace only: acceleration coefficient-gradient chain nonempty

law_patch.material: Same frozen rho0=2048,rhow=1000,n0=.25,Kw=67108864,K=89478488,G=134217728; M always derived from those loaded moduli, not assumed equal to E2^28. k0=double(float1e-4); Ck1/8; V0=.0625. J=1+(x-.5)/32+(z-.5)/64 except uniform fields.
law_patch.independent_reference: Independent O(N²) all-particle project Wendland float-fac evaluation, stored double positions/current actual C/current J, same Vj=V0Jj, Lp/Gp/Lx/divAce/GJ. ki=k0 exp((J-1)/(.75 Ck)); rate=B[-theta+ki/gamma*(Lp-Gp dot Lx+rho divAce)+alpha ki GJ dot(Gp+rho Ace)/gamma].
law_patch.labels: All ki/n/V/rho/GJ/chain columns are explicitly independent reference/derived values, NOT observed native GPU fields. Actual quantities are full float rate, reduced double speed, reduced maxcu2/Dmax, flags and copies. Inferred uniform ki is derived from actual Dmax, not a new production getter.
law_patch.budget: B=Kw/n,gamma=rhow*9.80665,alpha=1/(.75Ck). Raw= B[|theta|+ki/gamma*(sum|w dp|+absGp dot absLx+rho sum|V dAce dot CiGrad|)+|alpha ki|/gamma*absGJ dot(absGp+rho|Ace_i|)]. Per-row bound=64FLT_EPS*Raw+256DBL_EPS*max(1,|Btheta|)+1e-6Pa/s. Every rate/error/budget/ratio and each chain printed. This is a discrete implementation bound, not exact quadratic continuum truth.
law_patch.speed_budget: For uk=B/gamma*|alpha ki|*norm(GJ), bound=64FLT_EPS*B/gamma*|alpha ki|*norm(absGJ)+512DBL_EPS*max(1,|uk|)+1e-12m/s. Actual maximum compares against independent native maximum with max node budget. Nonempty chains/speed each exceed10x corresponding maximum budget.
law_patch.uniform_scale: Actual maxcu2 matches independent loaded-material ledger within64DBL_EPS relative; ki inferred from actual Dmax must match known uniform exponential law within5e-13*max(|kref|,DBL_MIN). Scalar and flag tail canaries unchanged.

guards.host: Six true Init rejections: Ck0,negative,NaN,Inf,denorm-min causing nonrepresentable alpha,lawON without DynamicPorePressure. Each caught before covered native state/clock/PRE change. A separate OFF+unused NaN Ck true Init positive control is accepted.
guards.device: Only legal Ck1e-6 with nonunit uniform J1.01/.99 is sent to actual rate/scales for exponent overflow/positive-base underflow0; expected invalid native slot0 plus flag/scalar canary. No demand that the private device helper reject invalid Ck at its J1/k0 short-circuits; parameter validation belongs to actual host Init.

active_cache_and_time.geometry: The already truly initialized512-native/960-slot rectangular X/Z periodic host fixture. No temporary injected host arrays/CSP/division state, no resize, no actual step.

High smooth coefficient contrast is deliberately manufactured to activate the necessary gradient bound, not a calibrated material or physical trajectory.
active_cache_and_time.actual_sequence: Actual FS/current-J C, actual owner map/C extension, actual complete host rate recomputes its cache. Independent O(N²) native max uk. Pressure rate remains exactly zero despite positive cache. No active cache is assigned by the fixture.
active_cache_and_time.domain_and_scales: Per-node current exponential ki determines independent Dmax and current J determines cu². Compare actual host pure wave/pore scales within64DBL_EPS. Require new complete=min(old complete,Safety*h/actual speed)>0 and <=.5old before request gates. This is not a sufficient stability theorem.
active_cache_and_time.unchanged_on_requests: Covered id/code/pos/J/v/p/p0/plastic/double stress,theta/rate/C/Ace,clock0/PREnull/DtModif0/cache unchanged. FixedDt telemetry may update as intended and receives the full new bound. No actual ComputeStep_Sym called.

periodic_law.cases: Two full960-slot host cases with512 normal fluid owners: lawON k0 compression and lawON positive current-J pressure/Ace field. Real C owner repair plus Ace/theta/rate extension, exact copies, clone-of-clone corner evidence and complete sentinel overwrite retained.

periodic_law.max_scope: Actual double max is over normal native fluid only; independent reference entries for periodic images do not contribute to max. This exercises multiple blocks without an output-only/native ki array.
